classes.label: A1 Both sides - full IRC section (>=3.3 m/side)
A2 Both sides - clear walkway (1.8-3.3 m/side)
B  One side only (>=1.8 m total)
D  No room - shared street / pedestrian priority
X  Excluded - BHU / Cantonment / BLW / Railway Board

currency.source: JRC GHSL GHS-POP, 2020 and 2025 epochs interpolated to 2023

currency.source: iFOREST flood-risk notebook (Sentinel-1 flood frequency, RP100 depth, composite hazard)
